title: Ad destination watchlist
description: Destinations to check for landing health and optional Shopify buyability. Hard caps: 25 ads, 10 unique URLs, 40 requests, 3 Shopify products, 90 seconds. Caps cannot be raised.

ads.title: Ads and destinations
ads.description: Each item is one ad destination URL. Multiple ads may share a URL; results fan out every linked adId. The prefill checks example.com plus Shopify's public Dawn demo product (Thelma sandal / Black 35).

adId.title: Ad ID
adId.description: Your ad or campaign identifier. Not fetched remotely.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Optional platform label: meta, tiktok, google, linkedin, or other. Not fetched remotely.

destinationUrl.title: Destination URL
destinationUrl.description: HTTPS landing URL to check (read-only GET).

expectedDomain.title: Expected domain
expectedDomain.description: If set, a final redirect host outside this domain is a failure.

requiredText.title: Required text
requiredText.description: All of these substrings must appear in the final HTML body.

forbiddenText.title: Forbidden text
forbiddenText.description: If any substring appears, the destination fails assertions (e.g. Sold out).

shopifyProductUrl.title: Shopify product URL
shopifyProductUrl.description: Optional. When set with variantId, also checks /products/{handle}.js.

label.title: Label
label.description: Optional label for this ad row. Not sent to destinations.

enableShopifyChecks.title: Enable Shopify checks
enableShopifyChecks.description: When false, shopifyProductUrl / variantId fields are ignored and no Shopify request is sent.

previousSnapshot.title: Previous snapshot
previousSnapshot.description: Optional OUTPUT.snapshot from an earlier run. Used for two-strike confirmation when you are not on a saved Apify task.

stateScope.title: State scope
stateScope.description: Optional persistence name for local or non-task runs. An Apify task ID always wins so two tasks cannot share state by accident.

maxAds.title: Ad cap
maxAds.description: Optional ad count cap of 25 or less.

maxUniqueUrls.title: Unique URL cap
maxUniqueUrls.description: Optional unique destination URL cap of 10 or less.

maxRequests.title: Request cap
maxRequests.description: Optional HTTP request budget of 40 or less (robots, redirects, retries included).

maxShopifyProducts.title: Shopify product cap
maxShopifyProducts.description: Optional Shopify product cap of 3 or less.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout seconds
timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock budget for this run. Cannot exceed 90.

confirmFailures.title: Confirm failures (strikes)
confirmFailures.description: Consecutive failure observations required before confirmedFailure / confirmedShopifyFailure. Default 2. Cannot exceed 2.
